title: Hass Zero
summary: Control your Home Assistant favourites from the CardputerZero
description: Hass Zero is an unofficial Home Assistant client: your favourite entities with live state, one key to toggle lights and switches, run scenes and scripts, open and close covers, lock and unlock, play and pause media; a detail screen to set brightness, target temperature, cover position and volume; and a searchable list of every entity grouped by domain and area. Sign in by scanning one QR with your Home Assistant URL and a long-lived access token (tools/ha2qr.py makes it offline on your PC). Italian and English.
